description: This file defines a custom exception class TrialBalanceNotFoundException, which extends the AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException to handle cases where a trial balance resource is not found in the system.

classes.name: TrialBalanceNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a trial balance with specified identifiers does not exist.

methods.name: TrialBalanceNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific officeId and accountId, and constructs an appropriate error message.
